messages:
maria: Quick reminder — code freeze for v2.3 goes into effect TOMORROW at 18:00 UTC. If you need a late merge, please: 1) post the PR link here, 2) add a one-line risk & rollback plan, and 3) @maria + @sam. We'll triage exceptions by EOD. :warning:

jon: thanks — pushing a small docs-only change (PR #4591). low risk, tests green. tagging it here to avoid surprises. :+1:

kevin: fyi I have a small deps bump in #4588 that fixes flakiness in csv parser. tests pass locally but needs one more review. requesting late-merge exception — risk: low, rollback: revert commit, fallback: previous image available. @maria @sam

maria: please include a short CHANGELOG note in the PR body and mark the PR with the label `late-merge`. we need the rollback steps directly in the PR description. once that's done i'll take a look.

kevin: done — added changelog and rollback steps. PTAL @maria. also added the build artifacts hash.

release-bot: :robot_face: Reminder: release freeze for v2.3 starts in 6 hours (1779160800). To request an exception, comment `@maria` on this thread with PR and risk assessment.

olivia: Heads-up — we want to include a small metrics hotfix (#4602). It's a one-line guard, but it touches ingestion. Risk: moderate. Rollback: cherry-pick revert, and switch traffic to fallback collector for 10m. @maria @sam

maria: ok — metrics fix needs SRE signoff and a canary plan. sam, can you review the rollback readiness? specifically: can we flip collector flag within 2 minutes and is there a runbook?

sam: yes — can flip the flag, runbook updated. if we proceed, we'll do a 5% canary for 20 minutes then 25% for 15. I've added the runbook link in the PR. :white_check_mark:

jon: reviewer pinged on #4591, looks safe to me.

maria: decision: approve #4591 and #4588 as late-merges (docs/deps) — low risk. #4602 (metrics) is conditionally approved once SRE completes the canary plan (sam confirmed). All approved PRs must have `late-merge` label, changelog entry, explicit rollback, and a CI green + e2e run.

kevin: thanks — merging shortly. will notify when it's in main.

release-bot: :lock: Late-merge checklist applied to PRs with label `late-merge`. Automated note: ensure the PR includes CHANGELOG, rollback steps, and CI-green before merge.

maria: final reminder — if you intend to merge after freeze, add your PR here by 17:00 UTC for manual triage. after 18:00 only emergency fixes with SEV owner signoff. thanks everyone! :rocket:
